question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

In all her sorrow she must weep or she will ____.
solution:
Here the correct answer is** Suffer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the context of the sentence,** "In all her sorrow she must weep or she will suffer," **it suggests that if she doesn't allow herself to express her sorrow through weeping, she will continue to experience emotional pain or distress.
